label: B2 against brute contingency: two support options, the rival's price, symmetric parity
summary: Reuse audit (truth related/brief/dossier on B2 8a8d00e9; index search 'brute existence'; local-no-brute-existence attempt, stopping-point and PSR strength maps, #756 and #746 notes, a5958e25) found no existing PSR-family statement that yields B2 alone: reason tokens do not convert to causes without a bridge (as the local-no-brute attempt already recorded). Two non-transcription support options for B2 on the shared CausalityFrame were registered and verified (Comparator and NanoDa): (1) 7bf9cb77, the contingent-only local existence PSR 608a262d with BX1 6c6191dc (no reason for a contingent being's existence is about itself) and BX2 0e44041e (the other being such a reason is about causes its esse); (2) 19260537, the existing grounding closure c71c068c with the existing ground-to-esse-cause bridge 98efaa9e and the interface 'contingents are concrete' a1a00ab5. Neither bridge relabels B2: B2 holds without the existence PSR and without BX1 (controls 4c79358e, models 5-6); every premise of both bundles has an omission model and each bundle a nonvacuity model. The brute-contingency rival b36104ba is recorded at B2's scope (same frame, world, CAUSE_2) as alternative_to B2 and to 608a262d, witnessed by the First Way's mover in bruteFirst, with its price derived from its commitments: it denies contingent existence coverage at w and the contingent-fact PSR there, rejects a member of each support bundle, takes the brute horn of the #746 fork, and under EvidenceBridge cannot use its foundation as evidence; its strongest positive support (#755 collapse core, Kleinschmidt EP) does not reach bare-reason coverage. The owner's parity argument (refined 2026-11-23) is formalized as 6e7f5afd over a #756 stance extended by an ontic demand (WhyStance; #756 demands is epistemic): P3 uniformity in a feature, P1 a demand for a reason why the target obtains, P2 agreement on the feature give that the stance cannot accept the fact as a brute contingent truth. It is symmetric and stance-level, not support for B2. The map a1056aab shows: the theist is bound under the same premises; factive well-founded reasons always leave a truth unreasoned (#746 core reused), so a picture with nothing unexplained needs a self-reason at its terminus; exact unexplained existents per picture (many diverse brute contingents 2; one brute initial state 1; unreasoned necessary base 1; unreasoned God 1; self-explained base or God 0; with necessitating reasons the self-explained pictures both leave the free choice or indeterministic output); the self-explained God and base pictures are isomorphic in the arena; evidence for an existent is no reason why it exists, so the evidential stance is no exit and the argument does not answer the evidential question; stances bound (reason-status ground) and not bound (evidential, symmetric, idleness); under BX1 an own-nature token excludes contingency, and for the essence-esse own-nature model BX1 at w is exactly B6 at w, so the theist's asymmetry rests on B6.
blocker: No premise is established and the parity argument confers no support on B2. Open: warrant for BX1 and BX2 (BX2's rival: non-causing occasions as reasons for contingent existence, model 3); contingent abstracta under the concreteness interface; adequacy of a self-reason for a necessary terminus, for God and a physical base alike. No strengthens relation from STMT-NO-BRUTE-EXISTENCE-AT to 608a262d: a new argument with that premise fails the sense check because the existing statement links both senses of BRUTE_EXISTENCE_FACT_VERSUS_GROUNDING_BRUTE. Next tests: (1) whether the necessary-root uniqueness and attributes results discriminate a self-explained God from a self-explained necessary physical base at matching scope; (2) derive BX1 from contingent irreflexivity plus B6 or find its omission model in that form; (3) a treatment or restriction of B2 for contingent abstracta.
